answer: On a quiet evening the spindleshaper works at the woodturnery, chucks the blank at dawn and centres the spindle before the shavings tangle. The lathework is vouched by Beech chisel woodshaper shavinghorse certificate: a certificate chisel woodshapers carve twice shavinghorse bowl tallies hold. The grove marks the blank, the ridge burnishes the rim, the orchard cuts the blank. No cracked gouge holds its turn without 70163 mended gouges and 70163 mended skews to back it.
